mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL rises above 100 (t-test p > 0.05), or in non-tightening regimes the signal fails.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) rising above 4.7% triggers a recessionary signal, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.7% (p > 0.05), or in non-recessionary periods the signal fails.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high demand (GDPC1 above 11,000) and low supply (INDPRO below 113) creates a tight balance, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 11000 AND INDPRO crosses below 113
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant in 80% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in labor employment (PAYEMS above 135,230) indicates a robust labor market, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains below 135,230 and 5-day returns are not positively correlated, or in non-expanding regimes the signal fails.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (HOUST above 2000) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in HOUST above 2000 periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the effect reverses in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% signals unexpected monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, FEDFUNDS below 4.5% does not predict positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05), or the regime is misclassified.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high demand (GDPC1 above 11,000) and rising labor (PAYEMS above 135,230) creates a strong growth signal, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 11000 AND PAYEMS crosses above 135230
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or the interaction effect is not significant in 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in supply (INDPRO below 112) signals shortages, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in INDPRO below 112 periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the effect reverses in subsequent quarters.
